scope: Connected native registered callback/backend poll/device start/BIOS execute/completion/device status/BIOS status. Four gate values, active/absent handles, BIOS states0/1/2/4/-1/unknown, four error classes and both FPU banks. Full retail RAM/CPU/FPU/SR/PR equality; independent BIOS dispatch order, state/progress/token/owner/error/media-change assertions. Only platform BIOS boundary modeled; status3 pending-query callback not covered.
